subject.title: fix(xai): gate server-side tools to xAI models only

question: Should xAI-billed `code_execution` and `x_search` be hidden whenever `activeModel.provider` is missing or not `xai`, or should OpenClaw preserve an explicit cross-provider/model-less use path?
rationale: The patch tightens a credential-backed provider billing boundary, but it also changes current behavior for existing xAI credentials, model-less tool catalogs, and any intentional cross-provider tool use.

options.title: Approve fail-closed default
options.body: Accept xAI-only tool exposure for active model turns, then require tests, docs, and real current-head proof before merge.

options.title: Require explicit opt-in
options.body: Preserve a cross-provider xAI tool path only behind a visible config or tool-policy opt-in with docs and upgrade proof.

options.title: Pause for broader policy
options.body: Hold this PR until provider-billed server-side tools have a shared policy across plugins.

recommendation.title: Approve fail-closed default
recommendation.body: Accept xAI-only tool exposure for active model turns, then require tests, docs, and real current-head proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The active-model plugin context and xAI/provider routing surfaces both appear in this owner history, making them the best available routing candidate for the boundary decision.
